title: iSTTC: A robust method for accurate estimation of intrinsic neural timescales from single-unit recordings
goal: Surpass the source-paper result on the same task: Estimate single-unit autocorrelation decay time constants from the same continuous and epoched spike observations. Synthetic Hawkes target is tau_ACF=tau_kernel/(1−alpha); empirical analysis estimates timescales and stability, not known biological truth.
primary_outputs: Candidate method and outputs for the source task: Estimate single-unit autocorrelation decay time constants from the same continuous and epoched spike observations. Synthetic Hawkes target is tau_ACF=tau_kernel/(1−alpha); empirical analysis estimates timescales and stability, not known biological truth.

Source-paper comparison for Original synthetic relative timescale-estimation error and fit-coverage profile, with separately labeled empirical pseudo-error/stability companions: Methods4.8 Eq21 displays 100*(tau_est−tau_truth)/tau_truth. Registered policy uses 100*abs(tau_est−tau_ref)/tau_ref and conditional mean/median summaries. Resolve the original figure-producing absolute/signed convention and masks from primary code before assigning a lower-is-better success criterion. Empirical reference is full-duration ACF/iSTTC, so pseudo-REE is stability rather than truth error.
success_criteria: Recover original figure-producing error formula, failure masks, continuous/trial/duration grids, author fitter and numerical baseline before admission.
Use the same original 100000 synthetic realizations and all retained registered empirical obligations; a finite 600-second/40-trial subprogram cannot establish a whole-task win.

Require meaningful improvement in an authenticated truth-based synthetic error metric and a valid paired uncertainty rule while retaining all original fit failures and coverage; do not minimize signed bias to manufacture accuracy.
Keep real-data pseudo-REE and area contrasts as consistency evidence, not true-timescale accuracy. Stronger area significance or reproducing the reference is not superiority.
A new simulation, trial-window seed, QC threshold, fit mask or held-out-parameter split is a separately labeled extension and cannot be compared to paper results as a same-task win.
The bound improvement contract must be improvement_ready and its complete same-task comparison and admission requirements must pass.
Reproduction is calibration only; reconstructing a numerical result, changing the task or split, or achieving stronger significance alone is not success.
